title: Buster Keaton's birth chart
metaDescription: Buster Keaton's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.3° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mercury holds a conjunction to Saturn at 0.0° — close enough to weld thinking to structure. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 11.3° of Libra is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Saturn in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Scorpio (6.6°), Venus in Virgo (18.6°), Mars in Libra (13.4°): thought steeped in tone and memory, attraction that grows by reliability, effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Saturn, a conjunction with 0.0° of slack. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Venus square Neptune at 0.6°, and Venus sextile Uranus at 0.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. The Sun in Libra at 11.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 18.6° is in fall; Mars in Libra at 13.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 4, water 3, fire 2, earth 1; modalities fixed 4, cardinal 3, mutable 3. Venus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 20.1°.
